queries.name: grand_totals_kpis
queries.purpose: Summarize the overall current performance and benchmark position across the model's main KPIs.
queries.intent: Grand totals for [Sales Actual], [Sales P20], [Sales P50], [Sales P80], [Bills Actual], [Bills P20], [Bills P50], [Bills P80], [Margin Actual %], [Margin P20 %], [Margin P50 %], [Margin P80 %], [Basket Value Actual], [Basket Value P20], [Basket Value P50], [Basket Value P80], [Sales vs Bench %], [Bills vs Bench %], [Margin vs Bench pp], [Basket Value vs Bench %], [Selected As Of Date], and [Last Updated], no filters, one row.

queries.name: store_performance_breakdown
queries.purpose: Show which stores are largest and how each store is performing versus benchmark.
queries.intent: Top 15 'Dim_Store'[store_no] rows summarized by [Sales Actual], [Bills Actual], [Margin Actual %], [Basket Value Actual], [Sales vs Bench %], [Bills vs Bench %], [Margin vs Bench pp], and [Basket Value vs Bench %], sorted by [Sales Actual] descending.

queries.name: department_performance_breakdown
queries.purpose: Compare departments on sales scale, benchmark gap, and bill penetration share.
queries.intent: Top 15 'Dim_Department'[DEPARTMENT] rows summarized by [Sales Actual], [Bills Actual], [Bill Penetration %], [Bill Penetration P50 %], [Margin Actual %], [Sales vs Bench %], [Bills vs Bench %], [Margin vs Bench pp], and [Basket Value vs Bench %], sorted by [Sales Actual] descending.

queries.name: section_by_department_matrix
queries.purpose: Identify the largest section and department combinations by sales and compare their benchmark gaps.
queries.intent: Top 15 combinations of 'Dim_Department'[DEPARTMENT] and 'Dim_Section'[SECTION], summarized by [Sales Actual], [Bills Actual], [Margin Actual %], [Sales vs Bench %], [Bills vs Bench %], and [Margin vs Bench pp], sorted by [Sales Actual] descending.

queries.name: category_performance_breakdown
queries.purpose: Highlight the highest-sales categories and their benchmark-relative performance.
queries.intent: Top 15 'Dim_Category'[CATEGORY_NAME] rows summarized by [Sales Actual], [Bills Actual], [Margin Actual %], [Basket Value Actual], [Sales vs Bench %], [Bills vs Bench %], [Margin vs Bench pp], and [Basket Value vs Bench %], sorted by [Sales Actual] descending.

queries.name: sales_trend_over_time
queries.purpose: Track how the main KPIs and benchmark bands move over time.
queries.intent: Top 15 'Dim_Date'[Date] rows summarized by [Sales Actual (Trend)], [Sales P20 (Trend)], [Sales P50 (Trend)], [Sales P80 (Trend)], [Bills Actual (Trend)], [Bills P50 (Trend)], [Margin Actual % (Trend)], [Margin P50 % (Trend)], [Basket Value Actual (Trend)], and [Basket Value P50 (Trend)], sorted by 'Dim_Date'[Date] descending.

queries.name: day_of_week_pattern
queries.purpose: Show whether performance differs by trading day of week.
queries.intent: All available 'Dim_Date'[DayOfWeek] rows summarized by [Sales Actual (Trend)], [Bills Actual (Trend)], [Margin Actual % (Trend)], [Basket Value Actual (Trend)], [Sales P50 (Trend)], [Bills P50 (Trend)], and [Margin P50 % (Trend)], sorted by [Sales Actual (Trend)] descending.

queries.name: performance_band_counts
queries.purpose: Summarize how many sections and categories fall into each performance bucket.
queries.intent: One row with [Section Underperforming Count], [Section Before Benchmark Count], [Section After Benchmark Count], [Section Outperforming Count], [Category Underperforming Count], [Category Before Benchmark Count], [Category After Benchmark Count], and [Category Outperforming Count], no filters.
